CustomField.description: Fit score band, for reports: 75-100 High, 60-74 Medium, 40-59, Under 40, Not scored.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Fit_Score__c), "Not scored", IF(Fit_Score__c >= 75, "75-100 High", IF(Fit_Score__c >= 60, "60-74 Medium", IF(Fit_Score__c >= 40, "40-59", "Under 40"))))
CustomField.label: Fit Band
